items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear and the formatting matches the repo. However, none of the exported API is documented: NewEncryptor, EncryptWriter, DecryptReader, LoadKey, Config and Validate have no doc comments. The chunk/MAC framing logic in decryptReader.Read has no inline comments either.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Package structure is sensible, but decryptReader.Read (~50 lines) mixes header handling, buffering, MAC and framing. Config.Validate repeats a near-identical 'mutually exclusive' check for each source. The handler's closer-ordering prepend (append([]io.Closer{gw}, innerClosers...)) is awkward.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: In Read, an EOF or ErrUnexpectedEOF while reading the length prefix sets done=true and returns io.EOF. A stream cut at a chunk boundary, with no sentinel or HMAC, is therefore accepted silently. Also make([]byte, chunkLen) trusts an unbounded length, and the handler wraps errors with %v instead of %w.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: The mandated signature changes are made and every caller is updated (storage tests, PathGenerator, handler). It also adds an unrequested exported option, WithEncryption. EnsureFileSuffix now leaves 'x.gz.enc' unchanged when gzip is on and encryption is off, where the old code appended .gz, a small change to unencrypted filenames.
